draft.text: You came in because you have high blood pressure and headaches.
We found that your blood pressure is not well-controlled with your current medication, Norvasc 10mg.
Your headaches may be related to stress or your high blood pressure.
Next steps will include discussing possible changes to your medication and tracking your blood pressure more regularly.
